To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
We have studied electron tunneling through redrox molecules adsorbed to a conductive substrate using scanning tunneling microscopy in an electrochemical environment.

the Fermi levels in the STM tip and the conductive substrate can be shifted relative to the redox levels of the adsorbed molecules by adjusting the substrate potential and that a tenfold increase in tunneling current is observed when the Fermi levels are aligned to an energy level of the molecule.

(1) the tunneling current between the substrate and STM tip via the redox molecules is strongly dependent on the substrate potential; and (2) by aligning the Fermi level of the substrate and the tip to a particular energy level, the tunneling current is greatly enhanced due to resonant electron transfer.
